ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a common-emitter transistor amplifier circuit, with the emitter of transistor VT grounded; the input signal ui is connected to the base through coupling capacitor C1, so the node at the right end of C1 is the base node seen looking into the input. The base bias branch goes from +UCC through sliding resistor RP and resistor RB to the base. The collector is connected to +UCC through RC, and the output is connected to load RL through coupling capacitor C2. Reasoning calculation: According to the problem statement RP=0 Ω, and UBEQ can be ignored. In DC, the base is equivalent to being supplied by +UCC through RB, so IBQ = UCC / RB = 12 V / 600 kΩ = 20 μA. The emitter quiescent current IEQ ≈ (β+1)IBQ = 101 × 20 μA = 2.02 mA. In AC small-signal analysis, +UCC is AC ground, and C1 is regarded as a short circuit, so the input resistance is RB in parallel with the transistor base input resistance rbe. rbe ≈ 300 Ω + (β+1)·26 mV / IEQ = 300 Ω + 101×26 mV / 2.02 mA ≈ 300 Ω + 1300 Ω ≈ 1.6 kΩ. Since RB = 600 kΩ is much greater than 1.6 kΩ, therefore Rin ≈ 600 kΩ || 1.6 kΩ ≈ 1.6 kΩ.

method.method_draft: First identify the input node after C1 as the transistor base. For DC bias, set RP=0 so the base is fed through RB from +UCC; with UBEQ negligible, compute IBQ = 12 V / 600 kΩ = 20 μA and IEQ ≈ 101 × 20 μA = 2.02 mA. In AC, +UCC is ground and C1 is a short, so the input sees RB in parallel with the transistor base resistance. Compute rbe ≈ 300 Ω + 101 × 26 mV / 2.02 mA ≈ 1.6 kΩ. Then Rin ≈ 600 kΩ || 1.6 kΩ ≈ 1.6 kΩ.

图像描述：图中是一个共射极晶体管放大电路，晶体管 VT 的发射极接地；输入信号 ui 通过耦合电容 C1 接到基极，因此 C1 右端的节点就是输入看进去的基极节点。基极偏置支路从 +UCC 经过滑动电阻 RP 和电阻 RB 接到基极。集电极通过 RC 接到 +UCC，输出经耦合电容 C2 接负载 RL。

method.method_draft: From the picture, model the input port as looking into the BJT base through the coupling capacitor, with RB connected from the base to AC ground.
